The customer explicitly denied initiating the transactions, confirming fraudulent activity.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized credit card transactions involving customer C07297 and card C07297-K1. On 2016-11-21, between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00, four unauthorized card-not-present transactions totaling $1,906.07 were processed across two distinct devices. The sequence began with transaction 3476602 for $478.95 originating in region 264 from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080'. Ten minutes later, transaction 3476633 for $456.96 was conducted from region 476 via mobile device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.2.1 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2208x1242'. A third transaction, 3476665 for $488.04, was completed at 20:24:00 using the same iOS device in region 476. The activity concluded at 20:30:00 with transaction 3476682 for $482.12 processed from the Windows desktop device in region 264. Cardholder C07297 contacted the bank stating they did not make transaction 3476682 and requested a card review. The activity is highly suspicious due to the rapid alternating usage of two separate new devices across disparate regions and transaction amounts structured to avoid round-number $500 authorization thresholds. In response to confirmed card repudiation exceeding the $1,000 threshold, card C07297-K1 was blocked and this filing submitted.

stop_reason: The investigation was closed pursuant to policy section 6 as customer repudiation provided conclusive proof of fraud and all required containment actions were completed.
